events_logged: agent_response (substance class only - no message contents)

repeated_confusion.shape: student asks the same conceptual question across 3+ sessions
repeated_confusion.action_at_threshold: Emit a candidate to promotion-candidates/; suggests a learning-skill that pre-empts the confusion

study_pattern_recurrence.shape: student runs the same study workflow (e.g., synthesize -> quiz -> review) 3+ times
study_pattern_recurrence.action_at_threshold: Surface to student; if confirmed, generate a study-workflow skill candidate

synthesis_request_pattern.shape: student requests synthesis across the same source set repeatedly
synthesis_request_pattern.action_at_threshold: Cache the synthesis + surface; if confirmed pattern, suggest a recurring-synthesis skill

assignment_workflow_pattern.shape: student approaches every assignment with the same structure (e.g., outline -> notes -> draft -> review)
assignment_workflow_pattern.action_at_threshold: Codify as a per-student assignment skill
